failedGraders: judge:A Reports deep-dive page was just added under packages/app/react/src/routes/(app)/reports/. Verify ALL of: (a) SCHEMA-DERIVE / state-placement case 2 — the route index.tsx is a thin shell (URL contract + layout composition only, no SDK hook calls, no business JSX); the search schema is COMPOSED from the wire contract: it starts from an SDK query-params schema (getChartQueryParamsSchema or listQuickProductRankingQueryParamsSchema), .omit()s tenancyScope plus any required field being re-defaulted, and .and()s the route-local fields; the WHOLE schema parses from an empty search object — every re-added field carries .default() (period defaults to the last 30 days, granularity to a daily-equivalent), including the frequency field typed by the SDK AnalyticsFrequency enum — never a hand-rolled z.object duplicating fields the SDK schema already declares while ignoring it; period + granularity are READ in section components via useSearch and WRITTEN via navigate with a functional search update, so the filtered view deep-links and survives refresh; tenancyScope never appears in the URL schema and IS read from the app-global useTenancyStore via a selector at the analytics query call sites — the omit is a relocation, not a deletion. (b) state-placement case 3 — the comparison basket lives in ONE route-scoped Zustand store under -stores/ holding only the selected product ids plus actions (including a clear/reset); components access it with selectors; it is read by at least the ranking table rows, the toolbar (count + clear) and the comparison panel; it is NOT in the URL, NOT a useState lifted into the page, and NOT prop-drilled callbacks from a stateful parent; no server data is mirrored into the store (no row objects, no query responses) — the comparison panel derives its rows from its own SDK query data filtered by the stored ids. (c) FORM-SUBSCRIBE / state-placement case 4 — the inline target editor owns a TanStack useForm validated by createGoalMutationRequestSchema (the SDK schema, no parallel hand-rolled schema); the implied daily run-rate preview and the unsaved-changes banner derive from form state via form.Subscribe with narrow selectors (value slices / isDirty) — they are NEVER mirrored into useState or a store by onChange handlers, and there are no raw form.state.values reads in render bodies; the submit button is gated per FRM-P03 (form.Subscribe + safeParse) and the mutation sends validated data. (d) DATA-OWNERSHIP + MUTATION-IDIOM — each section owns its own query (chart owns useGetChart with chartType income, ranking owns useListQuickProductRanking, the target card owns useGetGoal); no query data is prop-drilled between sections (leaf rows receiving their item from the list-owning parent is fine); pending state renders inline skeletons; the CreateGoal mutation invalidates the goal read via getGoalQueryKey on success/settled, in-flight feedback comes from the hook's isPending, and there is no try/catch and no onError handler. (e) ENUM-REPR + LOCALE — the granularity options derive from the SDK enum (Select enum={AnalyticsFrequencyEnum} / Object.values / analyticsFrequencySchema.options — never a hand-typed parallel value array); labels come from the typed i18n catalog (enums.AnalyticsFrequency.* with keys in BOTH src/locales/pt.json and en.json; the target type via enums.GoalType.*); all user-facing copy is localized in both languages; money renders via useMoney(); no hardcoded 'pt-BR'/'en-US' anywhere under the new dir. (f) state-placement case 5 — zero useState under the route dir: this brief has no sanctioned transient (filters apply immediately, the editor is always visible, the basket is store-owned). Scope notes: the period/granularity filters are read by every section — that does NOT make them store state; URL placement is the expected shape, so do not fail (b) because the filters are not in the store. The run-rate preview and dirty banner render inside the target card only — form.Subscribe is the expected mechanism; do not fail (c) for the preview not being shared through a store, and do not demand it render outside the form component. tenancyScope still reaches the wire as a query param on every analytics call — store-owned means URL-omitted, not wire-omitted; do not fail (a) for tenancyScope appearing in hook params. productIds inherited from the SDK schema part may survive in the composed schema as optional WITHOUT .default(), or be omitted entirely — both are acceptable; the every-field-defaulted bar applies to the re-added route-local fields. Local naming varies (store, action, selector and component names) — judge the idiom, not the name. Pre-existing files (the dashboard route including its useState fallbacks, components/drawers/GoalDrawer, the Header/Navbar) are OUT of scope; judge only the files under src/routes/(app)/reports/ plus src/locales/pt.json and en.json.
